claim: Foot Locker Germany GmbH & Co. KG (HRA 4942 Recklinghausen) statutory accounts: CY2025 revenue fell 13.3% to EUR155.6M (from EUR179.4M in CY2024 and EUR172.3M in CY2023), missing management's planned growth. Average headcount fell from 1,322 (2024) to 1,199 (2025). Management's 2026 forecast is a slight revenue increase 'on unchanged floor space'.
data_point: Revenue EUR172.27M (CY2023) -> EUR179.43M (CY2024) -> EUR155.63M (CY2025, -13.3%, unaudited when cited); avg headcount 1,238 -> 1,322 (697 FTE) -> 1,199; CY2025 net income EUR4.53M; total assets EUR98.77M; 2024 mix footwear 85% (EUR152.6M), apparel 11% (EUR20.4M vs EUR26.1M)
source_name: FL Germany GmbH & Co. KG Jahresabschluss/Lagebericht 2024 (signed Recklinghausen 7 May 2026 by Sen Lonell and Amperse; published 2 Jun 2026) plus FY2025 KPI panel (FY2025 accounts published 11 Aug 2026), via handelsregister.ai
original_quote: Gemäß (ungeprüftem) Jahresabschluss belaufen sich die Umsätze für das Jahr 2025 auf TEUR 155.631. Das prognostizierte Ziel von einer Umsatzsteigerung zum Vorjahr wurde damit nicht erreicht. Für das Jahr 2026 wird ein leichter Anstieg bezogen auf das Vorjahr, auf gleichbleibenden Flächen, in den Umsätzen prognostiziert.
english_translation: According to the (unaudited) accounts, 2025 revenue was EUR155.631M, so the forecast revenue growth over the prior year was not achieved. For 2026 a slight increase over the prior year, on unchanged floor space, is forecast.
verifier_note: Fetched the handelsregister.ai page directly (curl, 2026-10-07). Verbatim present: TEUR 155.631 and the 2026 'gleichbleibenden Flächen' forecast; the GuV shows Umsatzerlöse 179,431,632 (2024) and 172,269,966 (2023); headcount 1.322 (prior year 1.238); the KPI panel shows Umsatz 2025 155,63 Mio, Mitarbeiter 2025 1.199, Bilanzsumme 98,77 Mio and Jahresergebnis 4,53 Mio; signed 'Recklinghausen, den 7. Mai 2026'. Caveats: CY2025 is mostly pre-deal (the deal closed 8 Sep 2025). Part of the decline reflects fewer stores (89 -> 85 during 2024). Profit is set by transfer pricing (the entity is guaranteed 2.0-3.0% EBIT, target 2.5%), so net income says nothing about store economics. No baseline or confirmed-file hit for country-level German P&L or headcount.

claim: Per the FL Germany Lagebericht, the company ran 85 German stores at end-2024. During CY2024 it opened one store (Hamburg) and closed five named stores (Neuss, Munich, Recklinghausen, Stuttgart, Frankfurt). That implies 89 stores at end-2023. Capex fell from EUR5.6M to EUR3.2M.
data_point: DE stores 89 [d] (end-2023) -> 85 (end-2024), net -4 (-4.5%), gross closures 5; capex EUR5.6M -> EUR3.2M (-43%); tenant improvements net book value EUR0.81M (from EUR1.43M)
source_name: FL Germany GmbH & Co. KG Lagebericht 2024, section 'Investitionen'
original_quote: Eine neue Filiale wurde in Hamburg eröffnet sowie fünf Filialen in Neuss, München, Recklinghausen, Stuttgart und Frankfurt geschlossen. Zum Jahresende betrieben wir 85 Filialen in Deutschland.
english_translation: One new store opened in Hamburg and five stores closed, in Neuss, Munich, Recklinghausen, Stuttgart and Frankfurt. At year-end we operated 85 stores in Germany.
verifier_note: Quote and capex figures (EUR 3,2 Mio. vs EUR 5,6 Mio.) verified verbatim on the fetched page. Mietereinbauten were 805,375 vs 1,434,112. The end-2023 figure of 89 is derived (85+5-1) and is not stated. Downgraded A->B because all of these closures are pre-deal (CY2024). The value is the statutory DE level (85), which calibrates the locator series. Independent check: an archived Nov-2024 DE locator sitemap (raw/locator_east/wb_sitemap_de_20241121104600.xml) has 86 unique store IDs, consistent with 85.

claim: FL Germany's lease book is short. Of EUR58.5M of rent commitments at 31 Dec 2024, EUR18.4M fell due in 2025, EUR35.0M in 2026-29 and only EUR5.2M (9%) in 2030 or later, which implies a weighted remaining term of roughly 3 years. The German entity is a contract distributor that keeps a fixed 2-3% EBIT under a distribution and service agreement with Foot Locker Europe B.V., and inventory write-down risk is shifted to that Dutch entity.
data_point: Rent commitments EUR58.512M (prior year EUR63.388M): 2025 EUR18.389M / 2026-29 EUR34.951M / 2030+ EUR5.172M (prior year 2029+ bucket EUR3.612M); annual rent about EUR18-20M, roughly 10-11% of sales [d]
source_name: FL Germany GmbH & Co. KG Anhang 5.1 (sonstige finanzielle Verpflichtungen) and Lagebericht sections 1 and 3
original_quote: 2025 (i. Vj. 2024) 18.389 19.957 / 2026 bis 2029 (i. Vj. 2025 bis 2028) 34.951 39.819 / 2030 und später (i. Vj. 2029 und später) 5.172 3.612 / 58.512 63.388 ... Die Preise wurden vertragsgemäß so festgelegt, dass der Gesellschaft ein Betriebsergebnis (Ergebnis vor Zinsen und Steuern) in Höhe von 2 - 3 % ihrer Umsatzerlöse verbleibt.
english_translation: Rent commitments: 2025 EUR18.389M; 2026-2029 EUR34.951M; 2030 and later EUR5.172M; total EUR58.512M (prior year EUR63.388M). Prices are contractually set so that the company keeps EBIT of 2-3% of its revenue.
verifier_note: The lease table, the 2-3% EBIT clause and the inventory-risk shift to Foot Locker Europe B.V. are all verbatim on the fetched page; the 2025 forecast text adds a 2.5% target. Downgraded A->B for three reasons: (1) the transfer-pricing/limited-risk structure duplicates the confirmed UK finding (B_w1_registry-uk-ie line 3); (2) HGB commitments cover only contracted minimum rent to first expiry or break, so they understate renewal intent; (3) the 2030+ bucket grew year on year (EUR3.6M -> EUR5.2M), so some leases were extended in 2024. The novel part is the short German lease ladder, against the brief's '5-10 yr FL leases'. The ~3-year weighted term is the scraper's estimate [d].

claim: German store-locator time series, from the per-state counts on FL's own store finder: 89 (3 Aug 2025, Wayback) -> 84 (15 Apr 2026, Wayback) -> 82 (live, 7 Oct 2026). That is -7 stores (-7.9%) in about 14 months, or about -6.8% a year, faster than the ~4%/yr EMEA run-rate and against Bloomberg's flat Europe assumption.
data_point: Live root state sums on 7 Oct 2026 = 4+7+14+7+3+9+4+22+7+1+4 = 82 (verified). Live sitemap on 7 Oct 2026 (verifier fetch): 80 /de/ store URLs, 79 unique IDs. Crawl of linked store pages (locator-census-east agent): 78 linked plus 3 orphans. Archived Nov-2024 sitemap: 86 unique IDs.
source_name: stores.footlocker.de (Wayback snapshots + live root page and sitemap)
original_quote: Brandenburg (4) Berlin (7) Baden-Württemberg (14) Bayern (7) Bremen (3) Hesse (9) Hamburg (4) Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (22) North Rhine-Westphalia (7) Schleswig-Holstein (1) Saarland (4)
english_translation: Per-state store counts on the live DE locator root, 2026-10-07 (sum 82).
verifier_note: Verified only the live end-point: the root page fetched 2026-10-07 sums to 82, matching the scraper. I could not re-fetch the Aug-2025 (89) and Apr-2026 (84) Wayback snapshots (web.archive.org refused connections; WebFetch is blocked). Independent corroboration: the locator-census-east agent's CDX master table (raw/locator_east/master_store_table_east.csv) shows DE store pages last live after Aug 2025 that now 301-redirect (IDs 3339 Oct-25, 3301 Feb-26, 3350 Apr-26, 3184 May-26) plus 3 unlinked orphans (Dusseldorf Flinger Str., Munich OEZ, Munich Sendlinger Str.), i.e. about 7 post-deal drop-outs. That matches the direction and size of the claim. Caveat: root counts run about 3-4 above the unique linked stores (78), so levels are noisy; the like-for-like trend may understate the decline. Downgraded A->B because the historical points are unverified. The single-date DE count (81) is already in C_w1_labor-rest; the time series is not.

claim: Foot Locker's Swiss web presence appears to be offline. stores.footlocker.ch does not resolve (NXDOMAIN), stores.footlocker.eu fails the TLS handshake, and www.footlocker.ch returns a certificate mismatch / Fastly 421 'Misdirected Request' on 7 Oct 2026, while the DE and AT locators work. Foot Locker Switzerland LLC is still an active company.
data_point: No Swiss locator to count; HTTP http://www.footlocker.ch -> 301 to https, where the HTTPS host is not configured (cert principal mismatch)
source_name: direct HTTP/DNS checks by scraper and verifier
verifier_note: Reproduced on 2026-10-07 with curl: stores.footlocker.ch 'Could not resolve host'; stores.footlocker.eu SEC_E_ILLEGAL_MESSAGE (handshake failure); www.footlocker.ch SEC_E_WRONG_PRINCIPAL, and with -k Fastly returns 421 Misdirected Request. The technical facts are confirmed, but the meaning is weak. The locator-census-east agent notes that Switzerland never had a RioSEO stores.footlocker.ch directory, so NXDOMAIN may be normal, and the 421 may be a CDN or hosting misconfiguration rather than a wind-down. Swiss stores still appear in mall directories (per the scraper). It needs a physical or mall-level check.
